q_wand_awakening.title: Wand Awakening
q_wand_awakening.desc: Speak with Ollivander in the courtyard and practice casting your Basic Cast and Stupefy on the Training Dummies.

q_spider_infestation.title: The Whispering Woods
q_spider_infestation.desc: The Forbidden Forest is crawling with venomous Acromantulas. Defeat 5 Acromantulas to protect the castle grounds.

q_dark_monolith.title: Shatter the Dark Monolith
q_dark_monolith.desc: A corrupted Dark Monolith has emerged near the Black Lake. Gather other wizards, shatter its obsidian core, and collect the ancient drops.
